title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.07565v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. Existing systems primarily target text-only interactions, leaving image-creation conversations underexplored. In image-creation tasks, useful follow-up edit suggestions must reflect user preferences, offer diverse directions, and remain executable on the current image. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. translated_title: 下一步编辑什么：对话系统中视觉对齐的图像编辑后续建议
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07565v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：对话助手越来越多地推荐后续编辑以帮助用户继续任务。现有系统主要针对纯文本交互，使得图像创作对话未被充分探索。在图像创作任务中，有用的后续编辑建议必须反映用户偏好，提供多样化的方向，并在当前图像上保持可执行性。我们从Qwen应用收集了10万个真实的多轮图像创作对话样本，发现其中80.1%依赖于图像，这强调了多模态推荐的必要性。我们通过一个三阶段框架来处理这一设置。在第一阶段，我们使用真实在线数据构建一个经人工审核的适当后续编辑意图表，然后创建监督微调目标并微调多模态策略。在第二阶段，为使规则引导的监督微调建议与真实用户选择对齐，我们使用用户点击反馈通过多目标强化学习优化策略。
tldr: 该论文提出一个三阶段框架，利用真实用户数据和强化学习，为对话系统中的图像编辑任务生成视觉对齐、反映用户偏好且可执行的后续建议，解决了多模态推荐中80.1%图像依赖交互未被探索的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage framework leveraging real user data and reinforcement learning to generate visually aligned, preference-reflecting, and executable follow-up edit suggestions for image-editing tasks in conversational systems, addressing the unexplored 80.1% image-dependent multimodal interactions.
